desc.allowFrom: Restrict which senders can trigger this channel. Leave empty for no restriction.
desc.allowOrigins: Restrict browser origins allowed to connect over WebSocket.
desc.allowTokenQuery: Allow the access token to be passed as a query parameter.
desc.appId: App ID from the platform application credentials.
desc.appSecret: App Secret from the platform application credentials.
desc.baseUrl: Override the platform API base URL. This is usually left unchanged.
desc.encryptKey: Encryption key for platform callback messages.
desc.groupTriggerMentionOnly: Only handle group messages that explicitly mention the bot.
desc.groupTriggerPrefixes: Only trigger the agent when a group message starts with one of these prefixes.
desc.isLark: Use Lark international endpoints instead of Feishu China.
desc.maxBase64FileSizeMiB: Maximum size of one inline file in MiB.
desc.maxConnections: Maximum concurrent connections accepted by the channel service.
desc.maxMessageLength: Maximum characters in one message before it is split.
desc.mentionOnly: Respond only when the bot is explicitly mentioned.
desc.pingInterval: Interval between heartbeat messages in seconds.
desc.placeholderEnabled: Send an updatable waiting placeholder while handling a message.
desc.proxy: HTTP or SOCKS proxy used for channel requests.
desc.randomReactionEmoji: Choose one of these reactions after receiving a message.
desc.sendMarkdown: Allow replies to use Markdown formatting.
desc.streamingEnabled: Update replies progressively instead of waiting for the complete result.
desc.streamingMinGrowthChars: Minimum number of new characters before another streaming update.
desc.telegramBaseUrl: Telegram Bot API endpoint, defaulting to https://api.telegram.org. This is not a proxy address.
desc.telegramProxy: HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy address. Put network proxies here, not in the API endpoint.
desc.token: Platform bot token used to authenticate the channel.
desc.typingEnabled: Send a typing state to the platform while handling a message.
desc.verificationToken: Token used to verify signatures on platform callbacks.
desc.weixinAllowFrom: QR binding fills this with the iLink user ID, normally ending in @im.wechat. Do not use a WeChat nickname.

config.workspace_hint: Base directory for agent file operations.
config.restrict_workspace_hint: Only allow file operations inside workspace.
config.split_on_marker_hint: Split long messages into short ones like real human chatting.
config.tool_feedback_enabled_hint: Send a short execution note into the current chat before each tool runs.
config.tool_feedback_separate_messages_hint: Keep each tool feedback update as its own chat message instead of reusing a single placeholder/progress message.
config.tool_feedback_max_args_length_hint: Maximum number of characters shown in each tool argument preview. Set to 0 to use the default.
config.exec_enabled_hint: Enable or disable command execution for the app. When disabled, no command requests will run.
config.allow_remote_hint: When enabled, remote sessions or non-local contexts can also run commands. When disabled, command execution stays limited to local safe contexts.
config.enable_deny_patterns_hint: When enabled, the app blocks commands that match its built-in dangerous patterns and the custom command blacklist below.
config.exec_timeout_seconds_hint: Maximum runtime for command requests. Set to 0 to use the default timeout.
config.custom_deny_patterns_hint: Add extra command-blocking rules, one regular expression per line. A command matching any rule here will be blocked.
config.custom_allow_patterns_hint: Add extra command-allow rules, one regular expression per line. A command matching any rule here skips blacklist matching, but other safety limits still apply.
config.pattern_detector_hint: Enter a command to test if it matches any blacklist or whitelist patterns.
config.pattern_detector_input_placeholder: Enter a command to test, e.g., rm -rf /tmp
config.allow_shell_execution_hint: Allow scheduled tasks to run commands by default. When disabled, users must pass command_confirm=true to schedule a command task.
config.cron_exec_timeout_hint: Maximum runtime for scheduled commands. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.
config.max_tokens_hint: Upper token limit per model response.
config.context_window_hint: Model input context capacity in tokens. Leave empty to use the default (4x max tokens).
config.max_tool_iterations_hint: Maximum tool-call loops in a single task.
config.summarize_threshold_hint: Start summarization after this many messages.
config.summarize_token_percent_hint: Used when conversation summary is triggered.
config.turn_profile_hint: Controls what context each request carries. Leave disabled to keep the normal chat behavior.
config.turn_profile_enabled_hint: When enabled, this policy applies to every new turn. When disabled, GoGoClaw uses the original context behavior.
config.turn_profile_history_hint: Default includes earlier messages from this session. Off makes the turn behave like a fresh chat and skips saving its result back to history.
config.turn_profile_system_prompt_hint: Default includes GoGoClaw identity, workspace, memory, and runtime instructions. Off keeps only system prompts explicitly supplied by the request.
config.turn_profile_skills_hint: Default includes available skills and active skill instructions. Off hides them. Allow List keeps only skill names entered one per line.
config.turn_profile_tools_hint: Default exposes normal tools. Off prevents tool calls. Allow List keeps only tool names entered one per line, such as web_search.
config.session_scope_hint: How chat context is isolated across peers/channels.
config.session_scope_per_channel_peer_desc: Separate context for each user in each channel.
config.session_scope_per_peer_desc: One context per user across channels.
config.session_scope_global_desc: All messages share one global context.
config.heartbeat_interval_hint: Interval in minutes between heartbeat signals.
config.monitor_usb_hint: Watch USB plug/unplug events when devices are enabled.
config.server_port_hint: HTTP port used by GoGoClaw Web.
config.launcher_section_hint: Changes in this section take effect after the launcher restarts.
config.gateway_restart_hint: Changes in this section take effect after the gateway restarts.
config.dashboard_password_confirm_hint: Enter the new login password again.
config.dashboard_password_required: Enter and confirm the new login password.
config.dashboard_password_mismatch: The login passwords do not match.
config.dashboard_password_min_length: Login password must be at least 8 characters.
config.lan_access_hint: Allow access from other devices on your local network.
config.allowed_cidrs_hint: Only clients from these CIDR ranges can access the service. One per line or comma-separated. Leave empty to allow all.
config.allow_localhost_bypass_hint: When enabled, localhost requests are allowed even when they do not match the allowed CIDRs. Disable this when the launcher is behind a same-host proxy.
config.trusted_proxy_cidrs_hint: Only proxies from these CIDR ranges may provide client IP information such as X-Forwarded-For. Leave empty to ignore proxy client IP headers.
config.evolution_section_hint: Let the agent learn from completed turns and prepare skill improvements.
config.evolution_enabled_hint: Record learning data for completed turns. Draft and apply modes can also generate skill updates.
config.evolution_mode_hint: Observe only records data, Draft prepares candidate skills, Apply can write accepted drafts into workspace skills.
config.evolution_state_dir_hint: Optional directory for evolution state. Leave empty to use the workspace default.
config.evolution_min_task_count_hint: Minimum related tasks required before a pattern can produce a draft.
config.evolution_min_success_ratio_hint: Required success ratio for clustered tasks. Use a value greater than 0 and up to 1.
config.evolution_cold_path_trigger_hint: Choose when draft generation runs for eligible learning records.
config.evolution_cold_path_times_hint: Run times for scheduled cold-path processing. Enter one HH:MM value per line.
config.mcp_section_hint: Configure MCP servers without editing config.json manually.
config.mcp_enabled_hint: Turn MCP server integration on or off.
config.mcp_servers_hint: Add, edit, or remove MCP servers.
config.reset_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to reset your unsaved changes back to the last saved state?
config.reset_success: Changes have been reset to the last saved state.
config.factory_reset_confirm_desc: This will reset all configuration to factory defaults. API keys and security credentials will be preserved. A backup of the current config will be created.
config.factory_reset_success: Configuration has been reset to factory defaults.
